desc: A hamster-shaped creature made of damp brown carpet with stitched seams and one fluorescent tube stuck in its back. Chibi game pet sprite in exactly the same art style, palette, rendering and shading as the reference otter, 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, standing full body filling the frame, dark navy 1px outline, muted colors, no ground shadow, no glow.
